new.stem: A 22-year-old man has a 2-cm thyroid nodule. His father, now deceased, had thyroid carcinoma and an abdominal tumour. Calcitonin is raised and fine-needle aspiration shows spindle cells with amyloid stroma. Which type of thyroid carcinoma is this?
new.explanation: Raised calcitonin with amyloid stroma is medullary carcinoma (parafollicular C cells); a familial pattern suggests MEN2 (RET).
